description: Find controls by words in their title, objective, rationale, criteria or questions, optionally filtered by domain, overlay, owner role or lifecycle stage. Returns summaries; use get_control for detail.

domain.description: Domain code or name, for example GOV or Governance

lifecycle_stage.description: Lifecycle stage key, for example deploy

overlay.description: Overlay code: PUB, PRV, HIR, GEN, AGT or BLD

owner_role.description: Owner role key, for example ai_governance_lead

text.description: Words that must all appear, for example 'human oversight'

name: search_controls
title: Search controls
